amplicon.paper_statement: NOT CHECKED - no one has read this paper's Methods. Confirm the primer pair and set status to 'verified' before relying on this for anything but denoising.
amplicon.primer_evidence: probed 6 runs: no primer matched; most common 5' 10-mer CCCGTCCCGG (0% of reads) - region must be confirmed from the paper
amplicon.max_trunc_len_reason: read length; no 3' read-through to avoid
amplicon.trunc_len_basis: RAW read bases. dada2::fastqPairedFilter removes trimLeft first and then truncates to truncLen - trimLeft, keeping only reads at least truncLen long, so a read contributes bases trimLeft+1 .. truncLen.
amplicon.read_through: not applicable to a single-end library
